nodes.description: Registry public state variable holding the trusted external registry contract instance used by every helper view function.
Constant bytes32 attribute key 'isTUSDMintRatifier' used to query the registry for mint ratifier rights.
Constant bytes32 attribute key 'isTUSDMintPausers' used to query the registry for mint pauser/checker rights.
Constant bytes32 attribute key 'hasPassedKYC/AML' used for KYC/AML compliance checks.
Constant bytes32 attribute key 'canBurn' used to check burn authorization.
Constant bytes32 attribute key 'isBlacklisted' used to check blacklist status.
Constant bytes32 attribute key 'isDepositAddress' used to check deposit address status.
Constant bytes32 attribute key 'isRegisteredContract' used to check registered contract status.
Public view function check(address addr, bytes32 attributes) that forwards an arbitrary attribute query to the registry.
Public view function isRatifier(address addr) checking the IS_MINT_RATIFIER attribute in the registry.
Public view function isChecker(address addr) checking the IS_MINT_PAUSER attribute in the registry.
Public view function passedKYC(address addr) checking the HAS_PASSED_KYC_AML attribute in the registry.
Public view function canBurn(address addr) checking the CAN_BURN attribute in the registry.
Public view function isBlacklisted(address addr) checking the IS_BLACKLISTED attribute in the registry.
Public view function isDepositAddress(address addr) checking the IS_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS attribute in the registry.
Public view function isRegisteredContract(address addr) checking the IS_REGISTERED_CONTRACT attribute in the registry.
External interface function Registry.hasAttribute(address,bytes32) view returns(bool) that is invoked on the hard-coded registry address.
Parameter addr of check(address addr, bytes32 attributes), a caller-supplied address forwarded to the registry.
Parameter attributes of check(address addr, bytes32 attributes), a caller-supplied attribute key forwarded to the registry.
Parameter addr of isRatifier(address addr), forwarded to registry.hasAttribute.
Parameter addr of isChecker(address addr), forwarded to registry.hasAttribute.
Parameter addr of passedKYC(address addr), forwarded to registry.hasAttribute.
Parameter addr of canBurn(address addr), forwarded to registry.hasAttribute.
Parameter addr of isBlacklisted(address addr), forwarded to registry.hasAttribute.
Parameter addr of isDepositAddress(address addr), forwarded to registry.hasAttribute.
Parameter addr of isRegisteredContract(address addr), forwarded to registry.hasAttribute.
First parameter (address) of the external Registry.hasAttribute interface declaration.
Second parameter (bytes32 attribute key) of the external Registry.hasAttribute interface declaration.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, attributes) inside check; trust depends entirely on the external registry contract.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, IS_MINT_RATIFIER) inside isRatifier; authorization depends on an external contract.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, IS_MINT_PAUSER) inside isChecker; authorization depends on an external contract.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, HAS_PASSED_KYC_AML) inside passedKYC; compliance result depends on an external contract.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, CAN_BURN) inside canBurn; burn authorization depends on an external contract.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, IS_BLACKLISTED) inside isBlacklisted; blacklist status depends on an external contract.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, IS_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS) inside isDepositAddress; deposit-address status depends on an external contract.
External call registry.hasAttribute(addr, IS_REGISTERED_CONTRACT) inside isRegisteredContract; registration status depends on an external contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The caller-supplied addr parameter has no independent semantics; it exists only as the address argument of the registry external call in check.
The caller-supplied attributes parameter only feeds the registry external call in check and can be folded into that unsafe operation.
